q: Floquet theory for periodic linear ODEs ẋ = A(t)x with A(t+T) = A(t) introduces the monodromy matrix M = Φ(T), where Φ is the fundamental matrix. Stability is determined by:
exp: Floquet multipliers (eigenvalues of the monodromy matrix) determine stability: all |λ| < 1 → asymptotic stability; any |λ| > 1 → instability; on |λ| = 1 → Lyapunov stable or center.
